component.name: OpenMynd
component.summary: Control your Teufel MYND speaker over Bluetooth

description.p: OpenMynd is an open source controller for the MYND open hardware speaker. It finds your speaker over Bluetooth Low Energy and lets you control it from the desktop.

ul.li: Volume, mute, EQ and source selection
Battery level, charging status and battery-friendly charging
Auto-off timer, ECO mode, LED brightness and sound icons

description.p: Requires a Bluetooth adapter and the BlueZ Bluetooth service.
First Linux desktop release, using BlueZ for Bluetooth.
